browserTests.scope: Skills, changelog links/mobile overflow, hash-matched downloads, offline validator, current copied reference/LLM source

current.name: @openpresentation/opf
current.summary: Shared measured quote body/source geometry, deterministic grid scores, optional candidate explanations and persisted pagination readability floors. Generated payload types are stricter.

current.name: @openpresentation/opf-render
current.summary: Render the shared accepted quote lines and source placement from core 0.8.0, with measured readability and overflow diagnostics.

current.name: @openpresentation/opf-pptx
current.summary: Export shared accepted quote lines and source placement as editable PowerPoint text. Native save/reopen and controlled text reimport are verified; OPF quote structure and general pixel equivalence are not preserved.

current.name: @openpresentation/opf-editor
current.summary: Edit quote sources and apply one-page readability policy changes with undo/redo. Offline authoring, pagination, export and text reimport use the published package set.

current.name: @openpresentation/cli
current.summary: Bundle core 0.8.0 and updated provider-neutral skills. Retain one-command offline installation, safe updates and status for all six OPF skills.

coreHistory.title: Shared quote layout and readable pagination
items: Measure quote body, attribution and source together, with accepted lines shared by preview and native export.
Persist selected readability floors during pagination and expose optional candidate scores and decision explanations.
Adopt deterministic grid-score-v2 and stricter generated content payload types. Full automatic layout repair remains under development.

coreHistory.title: Styled and merged tables
items: Add table cells with value, optional style, rowSpan and colSpan while retaining scalar and rich-array cells.
Validate merge ownership and covered null positions; preserve connected vertical merges during pagination.
Share anchor geometry and editable .value paths across the coordinated renderer, editor and PPTX packages.

coreHistory.title: Content-aware table layout
items: Share table row geometry and fitting across composition, rendering and native export.
Grow multiline rows into available space and reduce spare height before shrinking readable text.
Preserve complete rows, report real overflow and keep short-table geometry unchanged.

coreHistory.title: Rich table content
items: Accept rich TextRun arrays in table cells and headers alongside existing scalar values.
Measure actual run styles for overflow and pagination, preserving complete rows and repeated headers.
Generated types include the additional rich-array form; exhaustive scalar-only consumers need updating.

coreHistory.title: Complete embedded image example
items: Replace the truncated PNG in the asset-source-forms example with a complete project-authored image.
Verify the corrected example against the renderer baseline and coordinated image/export checks.

coreHistory.title: Shared composition and local tools
items: Add nested composition, weighted tracks, measured rich text and lists, overflow diagnostics and explicit pagination.
Expose browser-safe composition, pagination and CSV/TSV/JSON data conversion APIs.
Add six portable authoring, layout, preset, editing, export and inspection skills in the repository.
Use smaller structural TypeScript schema/catalog declarations; the narrative index uses records instead of templates.

coreHistory.title: Examples, documentation and reference warnings
items: Add non-fatal warnings for unknown catalog identifiers and broken catalog cross-links.
Ship validated example decks, reference documentation and the pinned repository README through package exports.
Document design precedence, content forms and the boundary between the open format and downstream services.

coreHistory.title: Flexible content shorthand
items: Accept mixed slide-root payloads as implicit blocks when no explicit type, blocks or regions are present.
Allow a single audience string alongside the existing array form.

coreHistory.title: Public package and raw specification
items: Publish raw schemas, catalogs, references and layout previews through the canonical OPF package.
Add typed spec-file manifests and provenance-enabled publication.
Correct the United Kingdom chart catalog identifier to united-kingdom. The internally prepared 0.2.0 version was never published.

coreHistory.title: Initial npm release
items: Publish the Open Presentation Format package with schemas, catalogs, generated types and local validation.
Establish the .opf.json convention for complete presentation documents.

boundary: Exact production deployment commit and lockfile select core 0.8.0. Public browser tests verify the app, current documentation/skills, all release dates and hash-matched registry showcase downloads. Served JavaScript fingerprints are recorded, not asserted byte-identical to unbundled npm files. Shared quote native PowerPoint evidence is separate; no new raster-equivalence claim is made.
